domainNotes: Choose .ai, not .si. '.si' was almost certainly a typo for '.ai', but .si is real: it is Slovenia's country domain. On Hostinger, .si costs $11.99 / ₹1,169 for the first year and $16.99 / ₹1,649 to renew (hostinger.com/tld/si-domain). It doesn't say 'AI', and anyone who hears 'AI consultant, askhemant dot…' will type .ai and reach whoever owns that name. Hostinger's .ai page lists $89.99 for the first year (a tracker showed $99.99 in Jul 2026) and $109.99/yr to renew, with a 2-year minimum, so about $190-210 (≈₹16.7-18.5K) up front (estimate). The .ai is not covered by Hostinger's free-domain offer (hostinger.com/tld/ai-domain). Buy askhemant.ai as the main domain and claim askhemant.com free with Premium as a redirect. Skip .si and .co. If cash is tight, launch on askhemant.com and add the .ai after the first payment, accepting the risk that someone registers it first. Caveat: availability is NOT verified. WHOIS/RDAP, Hostinger's live search and Instagram's username check were blocked, and the web-search budget ran out during the final synthesis. The research-phase web search found no business using 'AskHemant'. 'GeneX' was rejected because GenexAI, GeneX AI chat, GeneXus and GENEX Services already use it. Run the 5-minute check (Hostinger search, not marked 'premium'; lookup.icann.org; Instagram username check; IP India and USPTO in Classes 35 and 42) before paying.

audiencePains: The first reply is slow: leads go cold while the broker is on a site visit, driving or asleep. Only about 37% of 2,241 US firms answered web leads within an hour (BYU/HBR audit), and only 3% of marketers reply within 5 minutes (NP Digital, Feb 2026)
Leads are scattered across portals, Meta forms, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp and calls, with no single list (vendor framing; confirm on calls)
Unqualified or junk Meta-ad leads waste calling time (hypothesis; measure in pilots)
Nobody follows up after day 2, and site visits or appointments are missed without reminders. Planet DDS reports a 6.9% dental no-show rate in 2025
Junior agents reply inconsistently, and the owner can't see what happened to each lead
Clinics miss calls during procedures and lunch, and have no recall or review-request process
Confusion about Meta's free WhatsApp Business AI (May/Jul 2026): 'Do I even need anyone?' The real gaps are CRM, routing, human handover and follow-up

discoveryCall: Free, gated, with a paid side door. The 20-minute Fit Call is booked on Cal.com Free at askhemant.ai/book: Tue-Thu 11:00-13:00 and 16:00-18:00 IST, plus 2 evening slots (19:30-21:00 IST) for the UK and US East, capped at 6 a week, on Google Meet. The intake form asks for business type, city or market, lead sources, leads a month, current reply speed, the task to fix first, and a budget band (<₹15K / ₹15-40K / ₹40K-1L / ₹1L+, with USD equivalents). People with a budget under ₹15K, or real-estate and clinic businesses with under 20 leads a month, get the Kit and the paid Ask Hemant Session (₹1,999 / $99, 45 minutes, credited to a build within 14 days); any other business with a budget of ₹15K or more keeps the Fit Call, with a Quick Win Build or an AI Build Scoping as the likely outcome. Why free: there is no proof yet and the audience is cold, and paid-call benchmarks (₹1,789 on Topmate; $150-300 abroad) assume a reputation already exists. Switch rule: if there are more than 8 calls a week, a show rate below 70%, or 3+ documented results by day 60, shorten the call to 15 minutes or make the ₹9,999 / $499 Audit the only way in. Reminders go out by Cal.com email plus a WhatsApp Business app message 2 hours before.

weeklyCadence: 3 Reels + 2 carousels + 2 trial reels a week, Stories on 5+ days. Mon: Reel (Lead Leaks demo). Tue: carousel (prices or templates) plus trial reel B of Monday's hook. Wed: Reel (Build Log). Thu: carousel (Field Test or clinic playbook) plus trial reel B. Fri: Reel (#AutomateKaro Hinglish or Dubai/English), testing a 7-9 pm IST slot against the default 2-5 pm. Sat: one 3-hour build and batch session that produces 3 Reels, 2 hooks and 2 carousel scripts. Sun: no post; 'Ask Hemant Sunday' question box and a 30-minute scorecard review. Daily, 40 minutes: reply to all comments and DMs, comment on 10-20 target accounts, and send 10 personal 1:1 messages to warm contacts or people who engaged (no cold mass DMs). From month 2: 1 collab and 1 Live a month, a weekly broadcast-channel post once there are about 300 followers, and Reels cross-posted to LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts. Mix: 60% real estate / 20% clinics / 20% general; 3-5 hashtags; original content only. Never drop below 3 posts a week.
brandVoice: A calm, practical builder who shows the work. Owner language, not tech jargon ('your portal lead waited 9 hours', not 'agentic RAG pipeline'). Show, then claim ('watch the timer', 'here's the log'). Every statistic carries a source and a sample size, and vendor statistics are never presented as Hemant's results. Honest about limits ('use Meta's free AI if you only need FAQs', 'here's what didn't work'). Prices published, with only real deadlines. Warm and bilingual: natural Hinglish for India, clean English for Dubai and international posts. Privacy-first (anonymised by default; nothing shown without permission). Banned: 'guaranteed ROI', income claims, '10x', 'revolutionary', fake scarcity, unlabelled demos. Signature phrases: 'No lead left on read.' 'Ask Hemant. Automate the rest.' 'Watch the timer.' 'Here's the real number.'
